scientific_integrity: All general assertions are established by a complete mathematical proof; finite tests are corroboration only. Historical searches cannot demonstrate absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: Counts only configurations initially fixed by three updates, not eventual basins or other periods. General regular-graph classification is by balanced 3-colorings, whose population can be hard to compute. Eigenvalue membership alone is insufficient. Historical priority is qualified by incomplete access to selected earlier full texts.
title: Half-degree rigidity and a sharp contact-threshold collapse on squared cycles
